description: GT image inserted at a random position (random.Random(42).randrange(N), drawn per sample in annotation order and per N in 5, 10, 20); other images keep their annotation order. gt_index is 1-based. Crop = target_bbox scaled 1.75x around its center, clipped to the image. Images are loaded with EXIF orientation applied (PIL ImageOps.exif_transpose), which is the frame the annotation sizes and boxes use.
